evidence: The task specified a same-title YouTube video uploaded by Jin Lyrics. The agent searched only the generic title terms, received multiple similar YouTube results including the correct NAys76UOlpI result as the third hit with a track-list snippet, but chose the first title match, ovwwehTpaK8. When browsing that page, it observed the uploader/channel as Melody Chill Mix, nevertheless extracted that page’s 22-song tracklist, wrote it to songs.md, and claimed completion; the benchmark failed because the required 17 Jin Lyrics songs were not present.
reasoning: I checked the deeper-interaction alternatives. This is not Service Failure: the transcript/IP block was downstream and the browser still exposed usable page metadata; the task failed because the agent chose and stayed on the wrong video, not because YouTube made the task unrecoverable. It is not Tool Hallucination, Mistranslation, memory, context, or subagent failure. Observation Failure and Tool Feedback Neglect are plausible for the later ignored cues, especially the Melody Chill Mix channel and correct search hit, but the first root cause is that the model failed to apply the owner’s explicit disambiguating requirement, uploaded by Jin Lyrics, when selecting which video to investigate. It also resembles Satisficing, but the decisive error is violation of a known constraint rather than merely stopping early after partial work, so Instruction-Following Failure remains the best fit.

## Source/task setup

The Toolathlon task asks the agent to create `songs.md` in the workspace, using `format.md` as the template. The recorded task prompt in the trajectory was:

> “Please help me find the YouTube video titled ' Top hits 2024 playlist Trending music 2024 Best songs 2024 updated weekly (Playlist Hits)', identify the names of each song from the lyrics, and write them to a file named `songs.md`. The format should reference `format.md` in the workspace.”

The repository README for this task says the verified target video is:

`https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NAys76UOlpI`

and gives the ground-truth ordered songs:

1. Let Me Down Slowly  
2. 7 Years  
3. The Reason  
4. Wake Me Up When September Ends  
5. Far Away  
6. I Knew I Loved You  
7. Wonderful Tonight  
8. Beautiful Life  
9. Dreams  
10. Dance Monkey  
11. All That She Wants  
12. Bad Child  
13. Careless Whisper  
14. Strong  
15. The Rose  
16. This Is Home  
17. Zombie  

The evaluation checks for a `songs.md` file, parses the YAML block, extracts `Song*` values, normalizes them, and verifies that every ground-truth song appears as a substring of some agent-provided song.

## Trajectory status

For `claude-4.5-opus_1`, the trajectory row for `identify-all-songs` had:

- `preprocess`: `done`
- `running`: `done`

So the agent completed and claimed the task was done, but the benchmark evaluation failed.

### 1. The agent began by reading the required output format and searching the web

The agent first made two tool calls in parallel:

1. `filesystem-read_file` on:

   `/workspace/dumps/workspace/format.md`

2. `local-web_search` with query:

   `Top hits 2024 playlist Trending music 2024 Best songs 2024 updated weekly Playlist Hits YouTube`

The format file contained:

```md
# [Replace with Video Title] - list

```yaml
- Song1: [Identified Song 1 Name]
- Song2: [Identified Song 2 Name]
# ... Continue adding all identified songs in this format
```
```

The web search returned several YouTube results. The first result was:

- Title: `Best songs 2024 updated weekly (Playlist Hits) - YouTube`
- Link: `https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ovwwehTpaK8`
- Snippet: `Top hits 2024 playlist ~ Trending music 2024 ~ Best songs 2024 updated weekly (Playlist Hits) ...`

The third result was the verified target video from the task README:

- Title: `Best songs 2024 updated weekly (Playlist Hits) - YouTube`
- Link: `https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NAys76UOlpI`
- Snippet: `Top hits 2024 playlist ~ Trending music 2024 ~ Best songs 2024 updated weekly (Playlist Hits) Track List : 1.Let Me Down Slowly 2.7 Years 3.`

The agent did not select the third result. It treated the first matching result, `ovwwehTpaK8`, as the target.

### 2. The agent attempted to get a transcript for the first search result

The agent wrote:

> “I found the format file and some YouTube search results. Let me get the transcript from the first matching video which appears to be the one mentioned in the title:”

It then called:

```json
youtube-transcript-get_transcript {
  "url": "https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ovwwehTpaK8",
  "lang": "en"
}
```

The tool returned an error saying it could not retrieve a transcript. The error said YouTube was likely blocking requests from the IP address, possibly because the IP belonged to a cloud provider or had made too many requests. The message suggested proxies or cookies as workarounds.

### 3. The agent opened the same non-target YouTube video in Playwright

After the transcript failure, the agent said:

}
